consent.title: Recording notice
consent.body: Tan records the audio and screen captures of meetings and conversations. Before you start recording, you must let the other people in the conversation know that it is being recorded; the obligations under personal data protection law (KVKK) are yours.

recordings.title: Recordings

settings.title: Settings
settings.empty: Settings will arrive in later releases.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.intro: Manage the variables and secrets the app uses here. Secret values are kept in a secure vault.

variables.title: Variables
variables.hint: Non-secret settings. Their values are shown in the list.
variables.deleteMessage: “{{name}}” will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.hint: Values are listed masked and only shown when you ask.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.revealNote: A revealed value is hidden again after 30 seconds.
secrets.valueHintEdit: Leave empty to keep the current value.
secrets.deleteMessage: “{{name}}” and its value will be deleted from the vault permanently. This cannot be undone.

vault.unavailableBody: Secrets cannot be stored on this machine. You can keep using variables.
vault.lockedBody: Enter the master password to access your secrets.
vault.setupBody: On this machine secrets are kept in a file encrypted with a master password. Set one to get started.
vault.statusFailed: Could not read the vault status.

unlock.title: Unlock the vault
unlock.description: Enter the master password to access your secrets.

setup.title: Set master password
setup.description: Secrets are encrypted with this password. If you forget it, the secrets cannot be recovered.

providers.intro: Manage the AI provider profiles used for transcription, image analysis and summaries. API keys are picked from the secrets in the Credentials vault.

list.title: Profiles
list.hint: A profile combines a provider, a model and (when needed) an API key.
list.empty: No profiles yet. Add a provider profile to get started.
list.name: Name
